action.option: Escalate 2018 for annual mortality peak follow-up

unexecuted_proposal.brief_basis: The chart 'Year vs. Mortality rate' shows the mortality rate rising over time, with the highest point at the final year, 2018 (approximately 9.1-9.2), which is visibly higher than 2010 (approximately 8.1) and all other years. The task asks to route the year that should receive peak-burden follow-up, which corresponds to the peak year 2018. The option 'Escalate 2018 for annual mortality peak follow-up' matches this.

rules.text: If the chart's x-axis labels are reporting years and the y-axis values are mortality rates, then the reporting year whose plotted point is highest on the page corresponds to the peak-burden year, and the public option naming that year is the supported escalation route.
rules.conditions: The x-axis tick labels bind to the plotted points as reporting years, the y-axis scale is comparable across all points, and the task's 'peak-burden follow-up' means the year with the maximum plotted mortality value.

rules.text: If the chart's y-axis label or title indicates a quantity other than mortality rate, or if the plotted series cannot be bound to the mortality metric named in the task, then the chart does not directly support selecting a peak-burden year, and the methodological or reference-review option becomes a substantively different motivated reading.
rules.conditions: The visible axis label or title must be checked against the task's mortality metric; a mismatch or ambiguity in the metric binding leaves the year-selection underdetermined.

rules.text: If two or more plotted points are at the same or nearly the same maximum height, or if the highest point's year label is ambiguous, then the peak year is not uniquely determined from the visible marks, and the support for a single-year escalation option is a support gap.
rules.conditions: The topmost plotted points must be compared in screen space, and their x-axis tick labels must be unambiguously readable to assign a single peak year.

observations.content: The x-axis shows tick labels '2006', '2008', '2010', '2012', '2014', '2016', '2018' from left to right.

A blue line with circular markers runs across the chart; the rightmost two points (above the 2017 and 2018 tick positions) are the highest on the page, with the final point at the far right appearing at or very near the top of the series.
The y-axis is labeled 'Count' with ticks at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8; the plotted points sit above the 8 tick, roughly between 8 and 9.
The title inscription reads 'Year vs. Mortality rate'.
